description: This PHP class defines an API endpoint for retrieving an employee's work shift information within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It includes methods for handling GET requests, validation of parameters, and leverages traits and models specific to the PIM module.

classes.name: EmployeeWorkShiftAPI
classes.description: Defines a RESTful API endpoint for fetching an employee's work shift details based on employee number.

methods.name: getOne
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve work shift details for a specific employee.

methods.name: getValidationRuleForGetOne
methods.description: Provides validation rules for the getOne method, ensuring the employee number parameter is valid.
